From 47 CFR 97.207(g)(1) (AMDDATE 2026-08-13), addressing: Under 47 CFR 97.207(g), how many days before integration must the FCC receive the pre-space notification?

A pre-space notification within 30 days after the date of launch vehicle determination, but no later than 90 days before integration of the space station into the launch vehicle. The notification must be in accordance with the provisions of Articles 9 and 11 of the International Telecommunication Union (ITU) Radio Regulations and must specify the information required by Appendix 4 and Resolution No. 642 of the ITU Radio Regulations.
